title: Gideon and the Homecoming
author: Tamsin Crane
blurb: Odile Vane, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
